description: Cookie-based authentication for Tusky Shop with hardcoded credentials (admin/password). Fastify backend sets signed cookies; React frontend manages auth state and route protection.

userStories.title: Backend cookie plugin
userStories.description: As a developer, I need cookie support in Fastify so auth can use signed cookies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/api/src/app/plugins/cookie.ts with secret for signing

userStories.title: Backend auth plugin
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an auth preHandler to protect routes.

userStories.title: Auth routes package
userStories.description: As a user, I need login/logout/me endpoints to authenticate.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate packages/backend/api-auth lib using Nx generator
POST /api/auth/login - validate admin/password, set signed cookie
GET /api/auth/me - return user if valid cookie
Auth routes registered without auth preHandler (public)

userStories.title: Protect existing routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need product and rating routes protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap productsRoutes + ratingsRoutes with auth preHandler

userStories.title: Shared auth types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared types for auth API contract.

userStories.title: Data access auth package
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need API functions for auth.

userStories.title: Auth context and hooks
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need auth state management.
acceptanceCriteria: Create useAuth() hook exposing user, login, logout, isLoading
Intercept API calls; on 401 response redirect to /login

userStories.title: Login page
userStories.description: As a user, I want a login form to authenticate.
acceptanceCriteria: Submit calls login() and redirects to home on success
App nav hidden on login page (all nav behind auth)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Protected route component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a component to protect frontend routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Show loading state while checking auth

userStories.title: Integrate auth in app
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to wire auth into the shop app.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Update existing data-access packages
userStories.description: As a developer, I need existing API calls to include credentials.

userStories.title: Navbar auth UI
